| Raven Reader | **B** | electron-updater with automatic check-and-install, backed by macOS notarization/hardened runtime (Apple Developer ID via OS trust store) plus a sha512 checksum in the update manifest. Standard, reasonably sound electron-updater posture — but the repo has been **archived since 2023**, so the update feed/infrastructure (GitHub Releases + a DigitalOcean Spaces bucket) may itself be stale or unmaintained going forward. |
